rationale: This is a motor vehicle collision with damage to the policyholder's own vehicle and injuries sustained by the policyholder, clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at 8:15am yesterday on Route 9 by another vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. Vehicle is totaled with severe trunk damage, and policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's information is documented on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
